name: Mahj Brooklyn
description: Brooklyn American mahjong instruction led by Lisa Schwartz. Site quote: 'Mahj Brooklyn offers American mahjong instruction through individualized lessons and group classes and pop-up events'. Studio in North Park Slope; pop-ups at Brooklyn restaurants and bars. Pop-up open play requires the 2026 NMJL card.
schedule: Mahj 101 two-part beginner series at the studio; pop-up open play at restaurants; private lessons $150/hr; studio group lessons $75/person/lesson
